title: Quiet Year — Cobalt Reach Kit
description: An unofficial, system-agnostic Foundry VTT v14 helper for running The Quiet Year inside an existing world: the four seasonal decks, reference journals, a Cobalt Reach scene, and a floating play surface for weeks, projects, resources, and Contempt. The Quiet Year is designed and written by Avery Alder and published by Buried Without Ceremony (buriedwithoutceremony.com/the-quiet-year); this is an AI-assisted personal-use build that carries none of the game's text, which the owner supplies from their own copy.

requires.reason: Relays a player's own Contempt adjustment to a GM client, since world settings are GM-write-only.
